decisions.reason: After several seasons the uncertainty is lower, but as a line close to the firm's core handcrafted assortment with likely modest carrying costs, it is still worth keeping unless sales evidence is clearly poor.
Because it is a peripheral add-on to the electronic music box line that was already abandoned, its standalone option value is now minimal and resources are better released.
This seasonal accessory depends heavily on the discontinued music-box concept, so further waiting is unlikely to reveal upside and the product should be withdrawn.
As a themed extension of the firm's established Christmas pyramid tradition, it still fits the core offer and can remain as a niche model at relatively low incremental cost.
